rigid_rotation_fit — DRIVE tactorque op

• Data kinds: matrix × matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.rigid_rotation_fit(pts, u, window=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tactorque; tactorque.rigid_rotation_fit(pts, u, window=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("rigid_rotation_fit"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

窓内のマーカー場に剛体変位 u ≈ t + ω ẑ×r を最小二乗で当てる: `t = 平均変位、omega` = Σ (x′u′_y − y′u′_x)/Σ r′²

(′ は窓内平均を引いたもの)、`resid_rms = 残差 RMS、n`。無滑りねじりでは円内が剛体回転(u_θ = βr)なので ω = β が真値

(平均 curl/2 は円の縁で当てはめが外に漏れて低くなる —— 実測 11 %)。`window` = (cx, cy, R)。Raises ValueError: 点が 3 未満。
